title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips | TechCrunch
summary: The new units, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, are part of the company’s eighth generation of chips introduced in April this year, and build on what those chips offered, which was more inference capacity and support for large training requirements.
